name: talk2tia
description: Work on Siemens TIA Portal V21 projects with AI: SCL and LAD blocks, libraries, tags, compile, diagnostics.
long_description: Talk2Tia is an open-source MCP server for Siemens TIA Portal V21 (Openness API). The assistant reads and edits SCL and LAD/FBD blocks, data blocks, UDTs and tags, manages libraries, compiles with located errors, compares online/offline, reads CPU diagnostics and shows a diff for every change. Destructive actions always need confirmation. Requires Windows with TIA Portal V21 and the Openness option, and your user in the 'Siemens TIA Openness' group.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Expose only the tools that do not change the project or the PLC.

toolsets.title: Toolsets
toolsets.description: Comma-separated toolsets to expose (portal, hardware, plc, online, diagnostics, diagnostics_write, library, hmi, object), or 'all'.
